sources.name: GameDecompLibrary
sources.use: Primary catalog: 304 projects (220 game decomps, 71 tools, 12 related) with platform, progress, methods, evidence links. Stored here as facts + paraphrased summaries; refreshed from the site catalog.json.

sources.name: Game-Decompilations list (SamidyFR)
sources.use: Alphabetical list of ~670 decomp repos; the ~480 not already in GameDecompLibrary were added with GitHub metadata, derived platform/type, and README-derived summaries.

sources.name: universal-modder (rehan-remade)
sources.use: Agent-written field notes (50 games, 9 techniques; 684 gotchas), 12 engine playbooks, 10 skills, `um` CLI. Index snapshotted in data/field-notes.json, playbooks.json, modder-skills.json; full text via the upstream clone or URLs. Contributions upstream only with the user's approval.

sources.name: decompedia (decompals)
sources.use: Decomp wiki: intro, MWCC/GCC/IDO compiler pages, platform pages, assembly patterns, $gp, line numbers, maspsx, decomp.dev guide. Paraphrased into decomp-matching-workflow references; no text copied.

sources.name: Deep-read repositories
sources.use: Shallow clones read for the skills: fromsoftware-rs (+vtable-rs, from-singleton), Thief3, BW1, AVP2, LEGOLAND, isle, Halo CE, FNV, objdiff, asm-differ, bsa-rs, esplugin, libloadorder, pelite, iced, binrw, unity-rs, jak-project, UnleashedRecomp... Clones are NOT redistributed; scripts/clone.sh fetches them on demand and refuses projects that forbid agent use.
